---
name: create-jtbd
description: Create a Job To Be Done (JTBD) statement from a stakeholder quote
---

From a stakeholder quote, create a JTBD statement that uses the structure: 
When [situation occurs], I want [desired outcome], so that [benefit].

The JTBD should describe what the stakeholder would want done, not how they would do it.

Return the JTBD statement in your response, along with the quote it was derived from, and the stakeholder it reflects.
